title: The text model lineup shifted
summary:
The text API gained new model options while access guidance, request handling, and the community catalog got tidier.

GPT-5 joined as a text-only model with tool support on the nectar tier, DeepSeek reasoning moved to DeepSeek R1 0528 on Vertex AI, and anonymous users gained `roblox-rp` with tool support. GPT-5 Nano was added on August 13 but removed from the model list the next day, so it is not a standing addition to the lineup.

The dashboard, access errors, and docs now point people to beta tier information instead of the retired Special Bee request flow. Published agent and workflow schemas use `tier` terminology. After two changes during the week, `openai-large` ended on the flower tier with a 5,000-character maximum input.

The text service now handles failures while sending error responses, the OpenAI-compatible client carries the model key through request transforms, and Bedrock conversations tolerate empty content or a first message that is not from a user. Request tracking also records timing, status, model selection, token usage, and moderation results.

EasyGen joined the chat projects list for turning prompts into editable Mermaid diagrams. Pollix AI, a multilingual assistant with image understanding, joined the project list and social bots catalog.
